avis.titre: THIS WORSENED MY SKIN WITHIN 3 DAYS USE

Second time using it i smelled the fragrance-y smell and that shouldve been the first and only red flag but i kept using it. I woke up and i saw a rash around my mouth but it looked like white bump, i thought it was heat rash so i didnt think much of it. So i used the product but i didn't put it around my mouth. The 3rd day it got progressively worst started burning especially in the sun (even though i always put sunscreen on) and the bumps were everywhere. I thought this is definitely not a "purging process", so I returned the product.

avis.titre: I can speak on it 100% YET however...
avis.texte: I am writing my review to personally tell you, if you have melasma, like I do this is NOT for you. Melasma needs professional grade attention. A prescription product I have (ulta wont let me post the name) does WONDERS for my melasma...works within a week. This product is for post acne marks and any discoloration due to outside sources and not from within like Melasma! and if you dont apply enough sunscreen on your face and reapplying sunscreen every 2 hours, you attempting to lightening ANYTHING is IMPOSSIBLE! Now come back and say this product doesnt work when youve used it for at LEAST 12-16 weeks and you are using sunscreen DAILY, without fail. The smell reminds me of a hair care product. I just wish I could think which one, but very familiar. So far, so good. I've only used it for a week or two. I will come back AFTER 12 weeks because I in fact use SUNSCREEN on my face. again, if you dont your review is NOT a fair assessment. it wont work without the sun protection. Saying that, use this along with facial sunscreen before you place your final review. Stick with it. 2 weeks, I am NOT shocked you see nothing. hyperpigmentation is DIFFICULT to treat reason its best to avoid breaking out in the first place FIRST through diet and good skin care for acne. I have incorporated this product into my routine for overall brightness of my natural skin tone for any dullness due to outside sources.

I originally started with the Ordinary Glycolic acid to help lighten my knees and hands, which did help. I just wanted something that required less work. It has been a little over a month, and I have not seen any improvement. I buy a lot of La Roche-Posay products, and this is the first one that did not live up to the reviews or the cost! The Ordinary is about 50% less and worked better. I'm not saying La Roche-Posay products don't work, especially since we all react differently to products. This one just did not work.

I tried this Mela B3 serum because I thought it would help with my Melasma but I was very wrong. This serum doesn't seem to be strong enough to treat Melasma and I've been using it for about 2 months.

Im still getting rid of this strange sandpaper texture it created on my skin and I am hoping it doesnt take too long to go away. I agree with other reviews that the smell is incredibly strong. avis.titre: Honest Experience After Finishing the Whole Bottle
avis.texte: I had high hopes for the La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Serum Dark Spot Corrector, but unfortunately, it just didn't deliver the results I was expecting. I took consistent before-and-after photos and saw little to no improvement in my dark spots—even after 6 weeks, 18 weeks, and ultimately finishing the entire bottle. It's possible that another product I introduced during that time may have affected the outcome, but even so, I expected at least some visible change after months of dedicated use. I also reached out to the company to ask if I might've used it incorrectly or if they had any tips, and unfortunately, I received a very generic response with no real guidance. Maybe you need to use the entire Mela B3 line to see results, but I purchased this serum on its own thinking it would make a difference—and in my case, it just didn't. If you're considering the investment, I'd suggest buying with caution. Everyone's skin is different, but for me, it just wasn't worth it.

avis.titre: Effective and Gentle Serum for Reducing Hyperpigmentation...
avis.texte: La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Serum: 4/5 La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Serum is a highly effective product for those looking to target hyperpigmentation and uneven skin tone. The combination of niacinamide (B3), tranexamic acid, and other active ingredients helps to reduce dark spots and brighten the complexion over time. The serum has a lightweight, non-greasy texture that absorbs quickly, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Pros: - Noticeable improvement in skin tone and reduction of dark spots with consistent use - Lightweight, fast-absorbing formula - Suitable for sensitive skin and does not cause irritation - Fragrance-free and paraben-free, minimizing the risk of allergic reactions Cons: - Results may take several weeks to become evident - Higher price point compared to some other serums on the market Overall, La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Serum is a reliable choice for those seeking to improve skin clarity and reduce pigmentation, though patience is required to see the full benefits.
This seems to be working really well. I have a brown spot on my face and after a few days is it fading a little. The bottle is really nice. The dropper is glass and good quality.

### Product Review of MELA B3 Serum **DARK SPOT CORRECTOR** MELA B3 Serum promises to fade dark spots and blemishes. However, effectiveness can vary among individuals, with some seeing results in a few weeks and others requiring a longer period. **VISIBLY UNIFYING** The serum helps even out skin tone, but immediate results are not always visible. Patience and a comprehensive skincare routine may be necessary. **CLARIFYING** The product has a purifying and cleansing effect, suitable for oily or acne-prone skin. Sensitive skin users should test it on a small area first to avoid irritation. **MELASYLT™** The MELASYLT™ ingredient helps inhibit melanin production, brightening the skin, but it requires time to see results. **Conclusion** MELA B3 Serum has the potential to improve dark spots and uneven skin tone. However, patience and combination with other products are key for optimal results. Always test beforehand and consult a dermatologist.
